Command.Statement: SELECT {[Measures].[Unit Sales]} ON COLUMNS, {Filter([Store].[USA].[CA].Children, Left([Store].CurrentMember.Name, 3) = "San" OR [Store].CurrentMember.Name = "Beverly Hills"), Filter([Store].[Store State].Members, NOT (InStr(1, [Store].CurrentMember.Caption, "A") > 0) AND [Store].CurrentMember.Name >= "O"), Filter([Store].[Store City].Members, [Measures].[Unit Sales] > 20000 AND Right([Store].CurrentMember.Name, 1) = "o")} ON ROWS FROM [ZFMSALES]
